section_summary.extract_value: This section describes how practice variability was operationalized in a single study by manipulating the number of changing target attributes. It details two practice conditions: a constant practice condition where three of nine attributes changed, and a variable practice condition where either three or six attributes changed randomly throughout the session. The study aimed for comparable difficulty across conditions.
